title: Minuta 2025-04-29
summary: The minutes of the April meeting show a unanimous hold at 5%, but the options analysis now put a 25bp cut on the table alongside the hold, and all Consejeros agreed the tariff shock's implications for inflation could require the TPM to approach the neutral range sooner than foreseen in the March IPoM. All agreed inflation risks had not materialised and seemed to be moderating (core below forecast, expectations near 3%), and several saw lower inflationary pressures ahead; the hold was chosen largely for tactical reasons, to gather information and avoid misreadings or unwanted market volatility, while some members still flagged high inflation and possible cost shocks. Versus the March minutes, where holding was 'la única opción plausible' and members stressed inflation persistence and readiness to act firmly, this is a clear dovish turn. The minutes are therefore more dovish than the same-meeting communique, which gave no hint that a cut had been discussed or that the easing path could be brought forward.

key_quotes.quote: No obstante, estaban de acuerdo en que las posibles implicancias del cambio de dicho escenario en la trayectoria inflacionaria podrían requerir que la TPM se acercara al rango neutral antes que lo previsto en el Informe de marzo.
key_quotes.context: Unanimous view that easing toward neutral may be brought forward

key_quotes.quote: En este contexto, se evaluó: (i) reducir la TPM en 25 puntos base (pb); (ii) mantener la TPM en 5%.
key_quotes.context: A cut was among the plausible options, unlike in March

key_quotes.quote: Varios Consejeros coincidieron en que la opción de bajar en esta Reunión podía causar lecturas erróneas sobre el impacto del escenario externo en la economía local o una volatilidad indeseada en el mercado, en un escenario que ya era volátil.
Todos los Consejeros destacaron que los riesgos para inflación no se habían materializado y parecían moderarse
key_quotes.context: Inflation risks moderating; some members still cite elevated inflation and cost shocks
